question: The mean of 2, 7, 5, 9, 14, 5 is m . The numbers 12, 17, 19, 64, 9, -54, p have mean m + 5 and median q . Then find the value of p + q .
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

m = (2+7+5+9+14+5) ÷ 6 = 42 ÷ 6 = 7

Mean of second set = m + 5 = 12 ⇒ Sum = 12 + 17 + 19 + 64 + 9 + (−54) + p = 12 × 7

⇒ 67 + p = 84 ⇒ p = 17

Second set sorted: −54, 9, 12, 17, 17, 19, 64 ⇒ median q = 4th value = 17

p + q = 17 + 17 = 34

**∴ The correct answer is p + q = 34.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Set 1: 2, 7, 5, 9, 14, 5 ⇒ Mean = m

Set 2: 12, 17, 19, 64, 9, −54, p ⇒ Mean = m + 5 | Median = q

Find: p + q

**Formula used:**

Mean = Sum of all values ÷ Number of values

Median of n values (n odd) = ((n+1)/2)th value after sorting
